units.source_text: 舞女的声音忽然飞进了我的耳朵。

en.t: The dancer's voice suddenly flew into my ears.

units.source_text: 我扭回头来，只见舞女和千代子并肩行走，

en.t: I turned my head back and saw the dancer and Chiyoko walking side by side,

units.source_text: 阿妈和百合子相距不远，随后跟着。

en.t: with Mother and Yuriko following close behind.

units.source_text: 她们似乎没有察觉我回头，千代子说：

en.t: They seemed not to have noticed that I had turned around, and Chiyoko said:
